title: A box the template made for a service and left empty is found (no-empty-boxes), filled with a button to the business's real way in, and that filling keeps the native structure
steps: S1: checkNoEmptyBoxes on a page read with one empty box (div.acm-opentable > div.ot-form, 1000×60) and on reads with none.

S2: compareAgentInventory on a home page whose ot-form group (empty at install) now holds a buttons block to tel:+19174643769; whose decorative jr-band group (empty at install) holds it instead; whose ot-form group is gone.
S3: serviceBoxesAsBefore on a nested empty service group filled with a button, and on a decorative div filled with a paragraph.
S4: browser reads a collapsed empty booking widget inside padded wrappers, a filled booking box, a hidden widget and a decorative band.
expect: S1: one finding naming the page, selector and size; none passes; CHECK_IDS includes no-empty-boxes.
S2: the filled service box passes; the filled band fails; the removed box fails.
S3: the service box reads empty again; the decorative div keeps its paragraph.
S4: the collapsed widget is reported with the visible wrapper size; the filled, hidden and decorative examples are not findings.

selectors.dom: elements whose class names a service: form, booking, reservation, widget, feed, embed, map, newsletter, subscribe, sign-up, opentable, calendar

evidence: Local round 31 (25/10/2026, WordPress JA Restaurant): an empty orange band under the hero, the template's OpenTable form group (.ot-form) empty at install.
fence: SERVICE_CLASS (reader and compare); emptyBoxes; checkNoEmptyBoxes; serviceBoxesAsBefore/filledBoxes

tests: no-empty-boxes fails each service box a page shows empty, and passes when none is
a service box the template left empty may be filled; a decorative box, or the box itself, may not change
a real read finds a service box shown empty, not a filled one or a decorative band
